validation.description: Test PIN encoding for security properties
requirements: Should not reveal original PIN through encoded output
Should produce different outputs for different seeds with same PIN
Should be resistant to brute force attacks
Should be resistant to rainbow table attacks
Should handle edge case PINs (0000, 9999) securely
